body: Email help@playorna.com and provide details/screenshots for suspected spoofing, they will investigate the player reported and take action if anything is found.

author: [deleted]
body: It's been known for a long time now that the notification system isn't flawless, especially when it comes to areas. They don't come through instantly most of the time. He could have taken those areas over the last couple hours, and you just now got the notifications in rapid succession. I've tested this myself, and it's not a sure sign of someone spoofing.
